rules.rationale: Growth Control KPI definitions are normalized analytics intelligence resources and require explicit object-level classification within existing intelligence and resource maps.
Growth Control activity-to-KPI bindings connect governed workflow composition to normalized intelligence definitions and require exact workflow classification.
Normalized measurements, bounded decision evidence, observability samples, and reconciliation findings are operational evidence surfaces requiring exact observability classification.

content.title: Growth Control Work Map schema classification repair

phases.objective: Restore fail-closed schema classification for the Growth Control analytics and observability objects and align the regression fixture with generator-owned registry classification.

e2e_journeys.actor: Work Map governance automation and reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Schema classification contract and regression tests on the exact candidate head
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every discovered Growth Control object has exactly one bounded registry rule while genuinely unresolved objects remain fail-closed.
steps: Discover schema objects from migration sources and enforce explicit-only namespace registration.
Classify the six Growth Control analytics and observability objects through bounded exact rules.
Generate the isolated fixture and confirm registry-classified objects are removed from the unresolved section before legacy validation.
Validate that a stale unresolved matrix entry is still recoverable through the registry and that an unknown object remains blocked.
assertions: Each Growth Control analytics or observability object matches exactly one bounded_exact rule.
No broad prefix fallback is added to the explicit-only Growth Control namespace.
The generated fixture reports only the genuinely unknown object as unresolved.
The stale coverage fixture still proves registry recovery behavior.
No generated Work Map, migration, database, runtime, provider, deployment, credential, or external-send mutation is performed.

phases.objective: Continuously detect explicit-only namespace drift when migrations add schema objects.
Exercise overlap, stale exact registration, and malformed registry failure paths.
Observe classification coverage and unresolved object counts on representative pull requests.
Require exact schema classification evidence before governed Work Map publication.
